summary: Sculptor Diversified Real Estate Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of CFO/Treasurer Ellen Conti and Chief Accounting Officer Scott Ciccone effective May 15, 2026, with no stated disagreement with the company or its advisor. On the same date, the board appointed Anthony Boni as CFO and Treasurer and Christine Yap as Chief Accounting Officer; both are current employees of Sculptor Capital Management. This is a routine executive succession involving internal promotions. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special situation is present. The filing contains no deal terms, prices, or shareholder votes. Monitor for any subsequent strategic moves but this filing itself is purely a management change.
